title: Our store must win AI-led discovery while PC costs and prices rise
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in discovery (NIQ); Shopify says AI discovery converts better. HP launched Experience AI; Newegg added Google UCP checkout. Q3 PC shipments fell 22.4% (Gartner); Prime Big Deal Days hit $9.86B.

points.headline: AI discovery converts, and rivals are opening agent checkout
points.detail: HP launched Experience AI, Newegg added Google UCP checkout, Amex built agent-purchase authorization. Make our catalog AI-readable, track AI-sourced traffic, and assess agent checkout readiness.

points.headline: PC volumes are falling while component costs lift prices
points.detail: Gartner shows Q3 PC shipments down 22.4% and Omdia 21%, with component costs lifting ASPs. Plan pricing, promotions and stock for a smaller, costlier market.

points.headline: Shoppers start with AI and big sale events concentrate demand
points.detail: 55% of consumers use AI in discovery (NIQ). Prime Big Deal Days drove $9.86B in US online sales with electronics up 85%. Align promotions with rival sale windows.
